messages:
Priya (Product): Quick async heads-up — I uploaded a compact "heatmap" snapshot for Q3 OKR milestone statuses. Can owners confirm shipped vs slipped, call out any hidden deps, and flag any CRs needing priority review? (TL;DR expected)

Miguel (Eng-Platform): Took a look — thanks. I can confirm: Dedicated autoscale UX changes = shipped (QA smoke passed).

Ava (Eng-ML): Model onboarding pipeline: partial ship — data validation tests still failing on a small edge case. Marking as slipped-to-next-week. Root cause: malformed examples in customer data. :warning:

Julien (Eng-Runtime): Batcher refactor is code-complete, perf tests next. CR is open: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/834 — needs 1 more review from infra. Pinging @Sam.

Sam (Eng-Infra): Re infra review — I'll take the CR tomorrow AM. Quick FYI: quota bump for staging GPUs still pending from cloud ops (ticket #4621). That could delay perf runs by ~48h.

Priya (Product): Noted. Ava — any way to mitigate the malformed example failures with a quick sanitizer to keep the milestone on track?

Ava (Eng-ML): Possibly yes. I can add a temporary sanitize step in the ETL that drops/normalizes offending records. Estimate +1 dev-day. If we do that, we can still finish validation by end of week.

Lina (PM): If it's +1 day and fixes the pipeline, go for sanitizer. Prefer to avoid shifting the OKR unless unavoidable.

Noah (QA): QA queue: if Julien's perf tests need staging GPUs, we should reprioritize other tests. Also, please add a short test plan in the PR so QA can triage faster.

Julien (Eng-Runtime): Will add test plan to PR today. Also calling out a fallback plan: if staging GPUs not available, I'll run perf subset on our small local nodes to get a baseline while we wait.

Miguel (Eng-Platform): Ownership clarification: Who owns the final rollout decision for the batcher change? Julien currently, but platform should coordinate. Suggest Miguel + Julien for rollout approvals.

Priya (Product): Agree. Miguel + Julien as co-owners for rollout signoff. I'll capture that in the OKR doc.

Sam (Eng-Infra): Quick dep: security needs to sign off on new sanitizer if it touches PII schemas — @Priya can you confirm the sanitizer will only touch schema-level normalizing (no retention changes)?

Priya (Product): Yes — it's a schema-normalize/drop step only, no retention/archival changes. I'll loop in security for a quick stamp.

Ava (Eng-ML): Also flagging a minor regression seen in nightly evals after quantization tuning — quality drop ~0.7% on the rerank metric. Not blocking ship, but we should monitor. Opening a spec doc with examples.

Miguel (Eng-Platform): Noted on metric regression. Recommend adding a quick eval job in the rollout canary to verify metric stays within guardrails.

Priya (Product): Good call. Miguel — can you add canary metric check to the rollout playbook?

Miguel (Eng-Platform): Yep, will add a canary check and the threshold.

Julien (Eng-Runtime): CR reviewer ping: @Sam — one more review needed. Also tagging @Noah for perf test plan once infra quota clears.

Sam (Eng-Infra): On it. Will review tonight and leave comments.

Priya (Product): Quick summary for the OKR doc (copy/pasteable): "Batcher refactor -> code complete; rollout owners: Miguel+Julien; CR pending infra review; perf runs pending GPU quota (ticket #4621). Model onboarding pipeline -> slipped by ~1 week unless sanitizer (+1 dev-day) is applied; security to confirm schema-only change. Monitoring: add canary eval check for quantization regressions."

Lina (PM): Adding that summary now.

OpsBot: Deployment ticket created: DEPLOY-1298 for batcher canary rollout. Assigned to Miguel and Julien.

Priya (Product): Two small asks before I close this thread: 1) Julien/Miguel — estimate for full rollout after perf results? 2) Ava — ETA for sanitizer PR if we proceed?

Julien (Eng-Runtime): If perf looks good and infra quota clears within 48h, I can target canary rollout in ~3 business days.

Miguel (Eng-Platform): Agree with Julien. Add +1 day for any unexpected test flakiness.

Ava (Eng-ML): I'll have the sanitizer PR ready in ~18-24 hours. I'll mark it WIP and request a quick security review.

Priya (Product): Perfect. I'll mark the milestone as "partial-shipped" with owners and these next-action ETAs. If anything changes, drop a quick reply here. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

Sam (Eng-Infra): Reviewing CR now.

Noah (QA): QA standing by for test plan.

Miguel (Eng-Platform): tagging this in the OKR tracker under Q3 -> "Serving/runtime improvements".

Priya (Product): Closing note: If anyone is swapping owners, ping me directly so I can update the doc.

Julien (Eng-Runtime): will do.

Ava (Eng-ML): thanks all.

Priya (Product): End.
